parameters.query:
WITH target_campaign AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.campaign_code,
        c.status,
        c.created_at,
        c.updated_at,
        c.pdf_file_name,
        c.pdf_drive_url,
        c.drive_folder_id,
        c.delivery_ready_at,

        cl.company_name,
        cl.name AS client_name,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM campaign_versions cv
            WHERE cv.campaign_id = c.id
        ) AS version_count

    FROM campaigns c

    JOIN clients cl
        ON cl.id = c.client_id

    WHERE c.campaign_code = $1

      AND c.portal_token = $2

      AND c.portal_token_expires_at > NOW()

    LIMIT 1
),

client_timeline AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        JSONB_AGG(
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'event_type',
                    event_type,

                'label',
                    CASE event_type
                        WHEN 'campaign_intake_saved'
                            THEN 'Brief received'

                        WHEN 'ai_campaign_version_created'
                            THEN 'Initial campaign draft prepared'

                        WHEN 'campaign_revision_requested'
                            THEN 'Revision requested'

                        WHEN 'ai_campaign_revision_created'
                            THEN 'Revised campaign prepared'

                        WHEN 'campaign_approved'
                            THEN 'Campaign approved'

                        WHEN 'production_tasks_created'
                            THEN 'Production planning started'

                        WHEN 'campaign_workspace_created'
                            THEN 'Campaign package ready'

                        ELSE 'Campaign updated'
                    END,

                'created_at',
                    created_at
            )

            ORDER BY created_at ASC
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS timeline

    FROM automation_logs

    WHERE campaign_id = (
        SELECT id
        FROM target_campaign
    )

      AND event_type IN (
          'campaign_intake_saved',
          'ai_campaign_version_created',
          'campaign_revision_requested',
          'ai_campaign_revision_created',
          'campaign_approved',
          'production_tasks_created',
          'campaign_workspace_created'
      )
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN target_campaign.id IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN target_campaign.id IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'valid'
        ELSE 'not_found'
    END AS result_status,

    target_campaign.campaign_code,
    target_campaign.company_name,
    target_campaign.client_name,
    target_campaign.status,
    target_campaign.version_count,
    target_campaign.created_at,
    target_campaign.updated_at,
    target_campaign.pdf_file_name,
    target_campaign.pdf_drive_url,
    target_campaign.drive_folder_id,
    target_campaign.delivery_ready_at,
    client_timeline.timeline

FROM client_timeline

LEFT JOIN target_campaign
    ON TRUE;

parameters.responseBody:
={{
  {
    success: $json.success,
    campaign: $json.success
      ? {
          code: $json.campaign_code,
          company_name: $json.company_name,
          client_name: $json.client_name,
          status: $json.status,
          version_count: Number($json.version_count),
          created_at: $json.created_at,
          updated_at: $json.updated_at
        }
      : null,

    timeline: $json.timeline ?? [],

    delivery: $json.success
      ? {
          ready: Boolean($json.delivery_ready_at),
          pdf_file_name: $json.pdf_file_name,
          pdf_url: $json.pdf_drive_url,
          folder_url: $json.drive_folder_id
            ? 'https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/' +
              $json.drive_folder_id
            : null,
          ready_at: $json.delivery_ready_at
        }
      : null,

    message: $json.success
      ? 'Campaign status loaded.'
      : 'The campaign link is invalid or expired.'
  }
}}
